content.about: Andorra is a tiny country high in the Pyrenees, between France and Spain. Its valleys are popular for skiing in winter and hiking in summer. It has two co-princes: the President of France and a Spanish bishop. Andorra la Vella is the highest capital city in Europe.

standout.text: Andorra is the only country where Catalan is the sole official language.

didYouKnow: Andorra la Vella sits at about 1,023 m.
It has one of the highest life expectancies in the world.
